ITEM.PTXT: An HDD update connector conforming to the IEEE1394 standard has been adopted, which allows map updates, etc. to be performed by connecting a dedicated HDD map update tool to the connector. This allows work such as map information updates to be performed without removing the map HDD (hard disk) from the vehicle.
A serial bus standard standardized by the 1394 committee of the IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronic Engineers).
